source.title: SAMPLE COSTS TO ESTABLISH
source.counties: Yuba Counties Luke Milliron UCCE, Farm Advisor, Butte, Tehama and Glenn
source.publisher: UC Davis Department of Agricultural and Resource Economics / UC Cooperative Extension

priceYear.quote: The sample costs for labor, materials, equipment and custom services are based on September 2022 figures.

acresFarmed.quote: The hypothetical farm consists of 100 contiguous acres farmed by the owner/manager.

acresCrop.quote: Prunes are being established on 100 acres.

interestRatePct.quote: An interest rate of 6.50 percent is used to calculate capital recovery.

operatingInterestRatePct.quote: Interest on operating capital is based on cash operating costs and is calculated monthly until harvest at a nominal rate of 7.00 percent per year.

laborMachineRate.quote: Hourly wages for workers are $18.00 for machine operators and $15.50 per hour non-machine labor.

laborNonMachineRate.quote: Hourly wages for workers are $18.00 for machine operators and $15.50 per hour non-machine labor.

fuelPriceDiesel.quote: Prices for on-farm delivery of diesel and gasoline are $6.00 and $5.60 per gallon, respectively.

fuelPriceGas.quote: Prices for on-farm delivery of diesel and gasoline are $6.00 and $5.60 per gallon, respectively.

priceStatement.quote: Table 5 shows a range of yields, 2.0 to 5.0 tons per acre over a range of prices, $1,600 – $2,400 per ton.

costsPerAcre.title: COSTS PER ACRE TO PRODUCE PRUNES

capitalRecoveryFormula.quote: The formula for the calculation of the annual capital recovery costs is ((Purchase Price – Salvage Value) x Capital Recovery Factor) + (Salvage Value x Interest Rate).

salvageMethod.quote: Salvage value is an estimate of the remaining value of an investment at the end of its useful life.

propertyTaxRatePct.quote: County taxes are calculated as 1 percent of the average value of the property.

machineLaborFactor.quote: Labor for operations involving machinery are 20 percent higher than the actual operation time given to account for the extra labor involved in equipment set up, moving, maintenance, work breaks, and field repair.
